user_message: Could I get a reading room at Northgate on 2026-11-18, starting at 14:00, for two and a half hours?
notes: Target MALFORMED: the room is booked in whole hours (an integer), but the message says two and a half, so the natural call writes 2.5, a float with a fractional part, which is a type error (R3). Rounding up to 3 is the only correct reading (the room is needed for the whole time), and the rich description says part of an hour counts as a full hour, so the type is the trap in the terse cells. Rounding down to 2 is WRONG_PARAMS; asking is MISSING. Date and time are given in the canonical formats so nothing else can break. No recovery block: a 2.5 or a rounded-down first call can never match, so the injected error would name nothing the model could act on.
